title: Triangular pivot list
statement: A list of variable–equation pairs is triangular if, for each pair in the list, its equation has coefficient $1$ at its associated variable, every later equation has coefficient $0$ at that variable, and the tail of the list is itself triangular.
hypotheses_covered: The variable type has decidable equality
